message_text: Dear Customer, your electricity connection will be disconnected tonight at 9:30 PM because your previous month bill was not updated. Please contact Electricity Officer immediately at 98XXXXXX01.
label: scam
warning_signs: Urgent disconnection threat, personal mobile number provided for payment/contact, pressure tactics

message_text: Congratulations! You have been awarded National Higher Education Scholarship worth Rs 50,000. Click http://scholarship-gov-grant.in/apply to pay processing fee of Rs 499 and claim now.
label: scam
warning_signs: Advance fee demand for free government scholarship, lookalike unofficial domain name

message_text: Dear Citizen, your SIM card services will be deactivated in 2 hours due to pending KYC verification. Update your details now on http://trai-kyc-update.com or call support.
label: scam
warning_signs: Fake urgency, threat of service deactivation, unofficial third-party domain

message_text: You have won a cash reward of Rs 25,00,000 in KBC Lottery. To claim your prize money, send processing tax to Bank Account No XXXXXXXXXX. Contact Manager on WhatsApp 91XXXXXX02.
label: scam
warning_signs: Advance tax/fee request for lottery never entered, unknown bank account details, WhatsApp contact

message_text: Urgent Notice from Income Tax Dept: Your tax refund of Rs 15,450 is approved. Click http://incometax-refund-portal.net to enter account details and receive funds instantly.
label: scam
warning_signs: Impersonation of tax authorities, suspicious non-government URL, credential harvesting

message_text: Part-time Work From Home Opportunity! Earn Rs 3,000 to Rs 8,000 daily by liking YouTube videos and rating hotels. No experience needed. Telegram @job_offer_hq to start.
label: scam
warning_signs: Unrealistic guaranteed earnings for simple tasks, redirection to Telegram, task-based investment scam

message_text: Work from home typist job available. Earn Rs 25,000 per month. Registration fee Rs 1,200 required for hardware kit dispatch. Pay via UPI to confirm registration.
label: scam
warning_signs: Demand for advance registration fee prior to employment, payment via personal UPI

message_text: SBI Emergency Alert: Your YONO account has been blocked due to missing PAN verification. Click http://sbi-yono-update.xyz to unblock immediately and avoid penalties.
label: scam
warning_signs: Threat of account block, fake banking URL using unofficial domain extension (.xyz)

message_text: Traffic Challan Alert: You have 1 unpaid challan of Rs 1,000 pending against vehicle MH-02-XX-XXXX. Pay now on http://echallan-parivahan-pay.info to avoid court summons.
label: scam
warning_signs: Threat of court action, fake parivahan domain link asking for instant payment

message_text: Hi Mom, my phone fell in water and screen broke. This is my friend temporary number. I urgently need Rs 15,000 to pay medical bill. Please UPI to 98XXXXXX03 immediately.
label: scam
warning_signs: Urgent emotional pressure, request to transfer money to unfamiliar account/number

message_text: Your order #84920 from eShop is out for delivery today. Track your driver real-time at http://eshop-tracking.link/track?id=84920
label: suspicious
warning_signs: Contains shortened/unfamiliar tracking link; sender identity not fully verified

message_text: Dear Customer, your broadband service plan expires in 3 days. Renew now to avoid disconnection. Visit http://fastnet-pay.com or call customer support.
label: suspicious
warning_signs: Generic expiry notice with URL; requires verification if user is an active customer of this ISP

message_text: Special offer! Get 80% discount on branded shoes and watches today only. Limited stock available. Visit http://super-deals-store.shop now!
label: suspicious
warning_signs: Unusually high discount offer, urgency timer, unverified e-commerce domain

message_text: You have received a package update from International Courier Services. Custom duties of Rs 450 are pending. Click http://express-courier-pay.top to clear shipment.
label: suspicious
warning_signs: Small fee demand for parcel clearance; potential courier scam pattern requiring official check

message_text: Dear Applicant, your online registration for City Marathon is received. View your bib number and schedule at http://citymarathon.org/bib-search
label: suspicious
warning_signs: Direct link provided; low threat indicator but domain authenticity needs verification

message_text: Dear Student, applications for National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship (NMMS) are open until 31st Oct. Apply online at official portal https://scholarships.gov.in
label: genuine
warning_signs: Official government domain (.gov.in), no fee requested, informative educational update

message_text: Your OTP for logging into HDFC NetBanking is 482019. Valid for 10 minutes. Do not share this OTP with anyone, including bank staff.
label: genuine
warning_signs: Standard transactional OTP message, explicit warning not to share sensitive codes

message_text: Your appointment with Dr. Sharma at City Care Hospital is confirmed for 22-Oct-2026 at 10:30 AM. For rescheduling, call 080-23456789.
label: genuine
warning_signs: Legitimate appointment confirmation with standard landline helpline, no suspicious payment link

message_text: Dear Income Tax Filer, your ITR for Assessment Year 2026-27 has been successfully processed. Check status on official portal https://eportal.incometax.gov.in
label: genuine
warning_signs: Official domain (.gov.in), standard status notice, no credential request

message_text: Your electricity bill for Account 102938475 is Rs 1,420 due on 28-Oct. Pay via official app or portal https://www.bescom.co.in
label: genuine
warning_signs: Standard utility bill alert pointing to verified state utility portal

message_text: Your Speed Post article ED123456789IN has been delivered on 21/10/2026 at Bengaluru GPO. Track at https://www.indiapost.gov.in
label: genuine
warning_signs: Official India Post domain (.gov.in), valid tracking number format, post-delivery update

message_text: Dear SBI Customer, statement for your Account ending 4321 for the month of September is sent to registered email. For assistance call 1800-11-2211.
label: genuine
warning_signs: Standard bank communication, official toll-free number provided, no external URL links
